title: COMI-LINGUA: Expert Annotated Large-Scale Dataset for Multitask NLP in Hindi-English Code-Mixing
reasoning: The paper introduces a dataset for multitasking in code-mixed Hindi-English and evaluates Large Language Models (LLMs) on it. Although the paper contains an 'Ethics Statement' and discusses 'Demographic Bias' in its annotation process within the limitations section, it does not evaluate or benchmark topics related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
